articles.title: An XRP treasury SPAC surges nearly 300% ahead of Evernorth merger
articles.snippet: Armada Acquisition Corp. II rose about 270% last week, leaving the thinly traded shell at nearly four times its roughly $10.50 trust value before merging with Evernorth, an XPR treasury company.

articles.title: Modern Treasury seeks US trust bank charter for digital asset custody
articles.snippet: The payments infrastructure company is seeking federal approval to offer stablecoin custody and related fiat services through a limited-purpose national trust bank.

articles.title: Advocacy group pushes back on banks’ lawsuit against OCC over charters
articles.snippet: CCI CEO Ji Hun Kim said that the organization “remains confident“ in the OCC’s approval of charters for crypto companies, despite a recent lawsuit and pushback from some lawmakers.

articles.title: OKX, NYSE parent file to launch tokenized US stock platform
articles.snippet: The stock trading platform seeks to offer tokenized shares in more than 60 US-listed companies under the SEC’s recently introduced innovation exemption.

articles.title: European crypto users have ‘more faith’ in regulated firms under MiCA: Bitpanda co-CEO
articles.snippet: Speaking on Cointelegraph’s Chain Reaction, Christian Trummer said MiCA has increased trust in regulated platforms and called for stricter enforcement against noncompliant firms.
